Lockstep release of the eight `@agent-ui-kit/*` packages (shared, icons, a2a, components, router, code, a2ui, app). First release since v0.1.0 (2026-08-26). Minor bump: it carries breaking export changes.

## Breaking
- components: the `./components` barrel and `./component-styles.css` exports are gone. Import controls through `./all`, `./all.css`, `./loader`, `./registry` or `./controls/*`; the seam sheet is `./shared-styles.css`.
- app: `./agent-admin-roster-source` exports renamed from Persona* to Agent* (`AgentRecord`, `AgentRosterView`, `AgentRosterSource`, `AgentRosterSourceOptions`).

## Changed
- Controls take the ADR-0245 derived foundations; ui-icon's old `glyph` prop and the `[scale]` / `[density]` attributes still work as bridges and are slated for removal in a later release (T-0353).

## Added
- shared: `./foundations.css` and `./foundations-bridge.css`, the derived geometry and type foundations (ADR-0245), with density moving the control ramp.
- components: generated `./all`, `./all.css`, `./registry` and `./loader` entry points (ADR-0233).
- a2ui: the selection and commit patterns (OptionDeck, OptionCompare, ConfirmReceipt, AmountPicker, StepFlow, Itinerary) in the producer stack; `./registry`, `./agent/model-capabilities` and `./agent/agent-bundle`; the `./agent` producer toolkit ships its prompts and sidecars embedded and imports from plain Node (ADR-0236).
- app: agent-admin overlay, value-digest, content-fields and compile modules.
- Every package declares `sideEffects`, so bundlers can tree-shake unused modules.

Full list of merged changes: https://github.com/kimgranlund/agent-ui/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged
